lines.text: You have a billing agent and a production agent, and both sit one tab apart.
You type a careful instruction. Refund the duplicate invoice, and nothing else.
And you send it to the production agent, because the wrong tab was still open.
With no delay, the agent reads it instantly and starts looking for invoice four eight two one.
With a send delay, the message is held for a countdown before it reaches any agent.
In that window, you glance up and see the wrong workspace name at the top.
Send Now and Cancel are right on the message, so the choice stays in your hands.
Cancel pulls it back. Nothing is sent, and the production agent never sees a word.
You switch to the billing workspace and paste the same message into the right place.
The countdown runs out, the billing agent gets it, and the refund goes through.
A tiny pause is a cheap way to avoid a big mistake, and it costs you a few seconds.
What is the worst message you ever sent to the wrong place? Tell us in the comments, and try the send delay at Agent R Q dot com.
